scope: One future UV venv creation and one future offline wheel-only hash-locked install; no target payload import, target interpreter invocation after package installation, bootstrap, model, GPU, DB or process observation now.

authority_bindings.review_caution: Conditional artifact acceptance does not register or dispatch setup. OPS current final review must be physically bound in any setup registration.

installer_provenance.flag_string_inspection_limit: Literal flags in a binary are not semantic or syntax validation. Missing '--' tokens do not prove unsupported flags. Exact proposed argv requires independent confirmation against hash-bound tool behavior/source; no launch-time flag/version fallback.

path_requirements: Drive C: and every existing ancestor must be rechecked by canonical handle/path immediately before any write; reject reparse/junction/symlink/UNC/ADS/drive drift.
Create runtime and cache once with exclusive absence preconditions; newly created descendants remain beneath their exact canonical roots. Refuse unexpected contents, reparse points or hardlink use.
No delete, move, overwrite, replacement of any old environment, .venv itself, artifact directory, prior receipt or generated partial environment.
Use --link-mode copy. Partial runtime/cache are retained and quarantined on failure or unknown outcome; no automatic cleanup/retry.

proposed_prerequisite_static_proof.tool: Read-only stdlib or PowerShell PE/file-data parser with exact source/executable identity frozen before use; no UV/Python target tests, networking or system-library execution.
proposed_prerequisite_static_proof.expected_path_presence_policy: Known base/UV files and system loader paths must exist at canonical roots; startup hooks and _pth candidates are exact presence/absence checks. Enumerate only direct startup filenames in declared base site directory. An unexpected hook or dependency outside this finite selection stops and needs new scope; no recursive system or stdlib expansion.
proposed_prerequisite_static_proof.UV_embedded_query_selection: Inspect hash-bound UV binary's embedded interpreter query and launcher argument/flag evidence as data to establish the exact stdlib-only interpreter query and safe-path/no-bytecode/startup behavior. If this cannot be justified statically, setup remains NOT_READY; a generic uv --help or interpreter test is not authorized by this proposal.
proposed_prerequisite_static_proof.API_set_policy: Map the direct UV/base PE API-set imports to their actual installed schema and selected system implementer paths. Bind direct named-system imports and canonical hashes. Stop at 64 rows or unresolved setup-relevant mapping; defer framework/helper DLL closure until pre-bootstrap proof.
proposed_prerequisite_static_proof.system_proof_limits: Selected setup-loader disposition, not exhaustive internal-C/OS behavior proof. No setup or GPU/model qualification follows from imported DLL names.

environment_policy.audit_values_policy: Record only the declared literal values and presence/refusal counts; never dump inherited values, credentials, tokens, URLs with secrets or machine-wide environment.
environment_policy.import_search_policy: The Rust UV executable uses the exact base interpreter for its own interpreter query. The cwd is an empty controlled work directory, not the repository or old site. Isolated/no-user/safe-path startup and exact base Lib roots must be established by the prerequisite proof; unexpected base .pth/customization/._pth hooks refuse. SETUPTOOLS_USE_DISTUTILS=stdlib is permitted only if the inspected base .pth condition proves it prevents _distutils_hack import. No old/global/project/user site or target wheel path is supplied to the base query.
environment_policy.installer_cwd_and_dll_caveat: Windows executable-directory/System32/API-set dependencies and UV internal dynamic loading still require the finite setup proof. Exact search-root binding is a prerequisite, not asserted from PATH alone.
environment_policy.no_network_boundary: --offline and --no-index, no inherited proxies/index/config values, exact local files only, and --no-python-downloads. Source/controller must reject every network attempt or remote asset fallback without widening scope.

commands.label: Single empty venv creation; no seeding; no target-wheel startup
Single local wheel installation into the new venv's site-packages; use base interpreter query only

command_design_rationale: --target plus --python exact BASE avoids invoking the generated runtime interpreter or its UV-generated _virtualenv.pth at installer-query time. The site-packages remains the new venv's declared import destination. Installer-generated entry-point placement must be captured and validated; no entry point is invoked.
No seed prevents pip/setuptools downloads or seed-wheel installation. No configs/projects prevent resolver settings inherited through local/global config discovery.

Explicit --no-compile-bytecode plus UV_COMPILE_BYTECODE=0 and PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 prohibit compilation; absence of compilation must be verified from actual artifacts/receipt, not assumed from default.
All command flags are proposed exact arguments. If statically unconfirmed semantics remain, or UV refuses the argv, stop; no command repair/retry or pip/alternate installer fallback.

setup_dose.deadline_coverage: Single monotonic 300-second deadline includes directory preparation, venv creation, install, bounded verification and verified empty owned-tree exit. Verification must not be used to report late success.
setup_dose.unknown_or_failure: Stop both command sequence and dependent work. Retain all partial artifacts, source/argv/environment policy hashes, terminal bytes, elapsed/bytes/tree identities and failure journal. No second environment, install, resolver attempt, fallback version, cache reuse or retry.

requirements: A concrete setup_controller.py must be written, frozen and independently reviewed before setup registration. This proposal is not that source.

Controller hashes/validates all selected runtime/installer/lock/wheels and exact argv before execution; starts suspended with Job assignment before resume; no-breakaway, kill-on-close, one owned tree, exact PID/creation identity, deadline/RSS/commit/disk accounting and verified exit.

Only exact UV executable and necessary base-interpreter stdlib queries are allowed in the installer tree. An unexpected executable/helper/network attempt/startup hook refuses. No framework, model, script entry point, generated venv Python after installation or package test is invoked.
Use appropriate narrowly bounded synthetic containment fixture/source review before a single setup registration; fixture success supplies no setup result.
Fresh separately authorized admission is needed at dispatch; this design does not inspect host/process/GPU/DB state or mutate native budgets. Preserve historical native charge and quarantines.

post_install_read_only_verification.complete_inventory: Enumerate only the canonical newly created runtime/cache roots; reject reparse/symlink and unexpected hardlinks/path escape/case collisions. Bound file count (100000), total bytes and stream hashing to the remaining combined deadline. Preserve full installed path/hash/size inventory.
post_install_read_only_verification.RECORD: Parse every installed distribution's METADATA/WHEEL/RECORD as data; exactly 25 locked names/versions; validate normalized paths, every nonempty hash/size for installed members and no unrecorded payload. Compare each wheel member hash/size to its canonical installed destination including .data scheme movement. RECORD itself and UV installer-generated bookkeeping/entry-point/launcher files require explicit generated-file disposition, not silent exemption.
post_install_read_only_verification.startup: Read pyvenv.cfg, bind include-system-site-packages=false and exact base home; hash new Scripts/python.exe/pythonw.exe launcher bytes and PE/header/base executable correspondence. Inspect all exact-root .pth/sitecustomize.py/usercustomize.py/._pth files. UV-generated _virtualenv.pth/_virtualenv.py, if created, must be quarantined as startup source and independently inspected before any later runtime invocation; refuse any other hook.
post_install_read_only_verification.bytecode_and_entrypoints: Refuse newly generated .pyc/__pycache__ under runtime/cache. Enumerate installed script entrypoints as inert data, bind their rewritten bytes/RECORD paths, and never invoke them.
post_install_read_only_verification.target_install_scheme: Verify that --target placed every wheel payload within runtime/Lib/site-packages or a declared installer-generated subpath beneath runtime. If actual entry-point/data placement is inconsistent with the reviewed scheme, stop without repair.
post_install_read_only_verification.receipt: Bind exact source/argv/tool/base/wheels/lock plus generated launcher, complete installation inventory and terminal evidence; record phase times, new bytes and verified exit separately from native-model accounting. Independent actual setup review is required.

before_any_bootstrap: Independent acceptance of actual setup and complete installed startup/launcher identities.
Fresh finite framework/helper/system DLL/API-set proof and exact sanitized runtime DLL/import roots; current full Torch/helper system closure remains explicitly unbound.
Separate new runtime-control source/contract/fixtures, exact clean commit, canonical accounting/admission and one registered no-model bootstrap dose. No target payload import is part of setup.
Dynamic internal-C loading/dispatch and actual loaded-native-module paths remain limitations requiring separately registered runtime checkpoints.
